next.reason: 2023 has no WRITE-specific rule; the general rule over every statement carries it: §2023:14.5.3.2 'The scope of a statement may be explicitly terminated by using its associated scope terminator as specified in Table 12', Table 12 pairs WRITE with END-WRITE, and §2023:14.5.3.2 GR1 and §2023:14.5.3.2 GR2 state what the terminator ends (the most recent unterminated WRITE and any unterminated statements nested in it), as 1985 IV-40 Scope of Statements did.
